evals.name: three-hook-ugc-scripts
evals.prompt: We sell a $39 portable blender (USB-C, 20-second blend, dishwasher safe) to 18–30 year olds in the US. Write TikTok ad creatives for a conversions campaign — we have two UGC creators who can film at home. Give me scripts I can brief them with.
evals.expected_output: Three creatives with different hook types, timestamped scripts with spoken line, on-screen text and visual direction, ad text ≤100 chars, display name, CTA Shop now, Spark Ads recommended for creator posts, sound licensing note, pinned comment and a testing plan.
assertions: Three creatives use distinct hook types (e.g. demo, statement, story) with hooks in the first 2 seconds
Scripts are timestamped with spoken line, on-screen text and visual per segment
Ad text is ≤100 characters and the display name ≤20 characters
Recommends Spark Ads for the creator videos and notes commercial music licensing
Includes a pinned comment and a testing plan isolating one variable

evals.name: adapt-polished-meta-video
evals.prompt: Our agency made a 30s 16:9 brand film for Meta with a voiceover and logo intro. Marketing wants to run it on TikTok as-is for a B2B scheduling app ($12/user/month). Tell me what to change and give me a native version.
evals.expected_output: Explains why the 16:9 logo-intro film will underperform on TikTok (format, hook timing, polish), then provides a re-cut native 9:16 script with a hook in the first 2 seconds, on-screen text, captions, and B2B-appropriate CTA (Learn more / Sign up), plus alternative hooks.
assertions: Identifies the specific problems: 16:9 aspect ratio, logo intro, voiceover polish, late hook
Provides a vertical 9:16 timestamped script with the hook in the first 2 seconds
CTA fits a B2B consideration/lead objective (Learn more, Sign up, Get quote)
Keeps essential text out of the bottom third / safe zones

evals.name: campaign-type-and-field-limits
evals.prompt: I'm new to TikTok Ads Manager. For a skincare brand doing about 70 orders a week from TikTok, should I use Smart+ or a normal in-feed campaign, and how long can the caption/headline/description be? Also draft the ad text for a retinol serum launch (€34, dermatologist tested).
evals.expected_output: Recommends testing Smart+ given ≥50 conversions/week while keeping a manual campaign as control; explains there is a single ad text field (≤100 chars, ~40 visible) and display name (≤20) rather than Meta-style headline/description for in-feed video; drafts compliant ad text and flags skincare claim policies.
assertions: Explains Smart+ suitability based on conversion volume and suggests a controlled test
Correctly states ad text is up to 100 characters with ~40 visible and that there is no separate headline/description for standard in-feed video
Drafted ad text is ≤100 characters and avoids unsubstantiated medical claims
Mentions policy caution for skincare/health claims
